newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai customs says March exports at 133 bln baht.
newsitem.headline: Thai customs says March exports at 133 bln baht.

text.p: Thailand's preliminary March exports were expected to reach 133 billion baht ($5.12 billion) compared with 113.15 billion baht in February, a senior customs department official said on Wednesday.

Pridi Boonyoung, head of the customs department, told reporters that while the exports edged up in the month, imports dropped below the figure reported in February. But he would not disclose the figure.
"With this trend, we expect the trade deficit in March to narrow further from February," he said.
Normally, the custom department's trade figure differs from the Bank of Thailand's which is regarded as official due to a different base and methods of calculation.
However, the figures from both agencies usually reflect the same trend.
According to the central bank's figure, February exports totalled 108.6 billion baht ($4.17 billion) and imports were 130.3 billion, resulting in a trade deficit of 21.7 billion baht. ($1 = 26 baht)
